searchText: Are people in Asia/Pacific allowed to attend the EU/East Coast meeting? 😬 22:00 is way easier for me than 06:00. yes, of course, you can attend both 🙂 <@!532525420264947714> please DM me with your email address so I can add you https://github.com/ethereum-oasis/eth1.x-JSON-RPC-API-standard/issues/9 Please have a look at the new resource in GitHub issues And there is also the previous recording available in the repo README which timezone are you in Micah? 00:30 right now. Singapore/Hong Kong +8 maybe I should book for midnight UTC? not sure why I picked 10pm hmmm I needed Australia, Asia and PST and I chose 10pm which seems wrong now shall we move it? or maybe 2am UTC? Personally, I can make the EU/East Coast meeting, so don't reschedule anything on my behalf. Unless you were *hoping* that I wouldn't show up to the EU/US one. 😉
